function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (e.g., P014, P034, etc.), and `sample_seq` shows that 48 rows have `sample_seq == 2`, meaning 24 patients were re-tested and appear twice in the dataset.", "implication": "If we compute the mean `biomarker_final` across all rows, we would double-weight the 24 re-tested patients. To get a patient-level mean, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` (as per the data dictionary: 'the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient')."}
function.name: note_finding
